help.tagPrefix: Prefix to be used for all tags, e.g. 'v' results in 'v1.0.0'. Only tags with given prefix are recognized.
help.initialNonPrefixedVersion: Initial version number if no version tag is found. The prefix will be added to it.
help.changelogFile: File to write the changelog to. Leave empty if you don't want to write a changelog.
help.compareUrlFormat: URL to compare two versions. Use {{previousTag}} and {{currentTag}} as placeholders.
help.commitUrlFormat: URL to a commit. Use {{hash}} as placeholder.
help.issueUrlFormat: URL to an issue. Use {{id}} as placeholder.
